Manifest.Description: 1.13 fixes the mother's household-goods visit: she now accepts both Household Good and Food instead of a hidden Nutrifruit-only exception, and the normal-branch text matches. Linked arrest bail/release scheduling now reuses only the native rescue eligibility and factories. The 1.12 harem bracelet fix, 1.11 portrait selector, 1.10 voice pass and earlier entry, hit-area and portrait-compatibility fixes remain. Simplified Chinese / English. 1.13 修复母亲的日用品来访：改为同时接受日用品和食物，移除隐藏的营养果特例，普通分支台词同步；被捕保释/释放调度只复用原生救援资格与工厂。保留 1.12 手镯修复、1.11 立绘选择、1.10 voice pass 与更早的入线、点击区、立绘兼容修复。简体中文 / English。
